prototypeScope: V1.30 delta package (D-023): one White plate with the U20 face panel, one Black plate with the U20 eye trim, the jaw support and the two loose halves (A, B) of the exit clamp, one Yellow plate with the lower head shell. The face and trim take the Innomaker U20CAM-720P USB camera 13.1 mm behind the face; the jaw support and the shell open the left-rear head exit to dia 11 so the camera cable leaves the head whole, and the jaw support carries the fixed half of the printed two-piece clamp that holds the wires there. Four parts replace printed parts, the two loose halves are new. The head cap is not reprinted; the four V1.9 wire clips are retired unfitted.
knownFitBoundary: Camera dimensions come from the ROBOTIS OMX-F CAD of the same camera, not from a measured unit: lens front 22.0 mm in front of the board, so it sits 0.4 mm behind the trim front. Boss pilots dia 1.7 for M2 x 6 (4.4 mm of thread); the trim bore dia 16.2 is 1.1 mm clear of the lens ring. The exit parts: the moved M2.6 seat and the clamp are new, not yet printed; the clamp barbs snap with 0.2 mm of interference, untested on a print; the camera cable diameter (4 mm) and the bundle size are assumed, hence the two loose halves. Printed sizes not measured.
processOverrideReason: V1.17 White overrides kept for the face (3 support interface layers at 0.15 spacing, 0.2 top z, interface 40 mm/s, bridge 30 mm/s, support ironing, 0.2 first layer); the face prints flat and needs no support. Black and Yellow: donor profiles as is (as V1.8 and V1.28).

parts.changeReason: D-023 (2026-10-22, revised 2026-10-23): the Innomaker U20CAM-720P USB camera takes the four face bosses. Its dimensions come from the ROBOTIS OMX-F CAD (face-u20/robotis-cad/): lens front 22.0 mm in front of the board, ring dia 14.0. The bosses grow from 4.0 to 13.1 mm behind the face back (dia 4.8, pilot dia 1.7, wall 1.55) so the board sits at x 67.0 and the lens front at x 89.0, 0.4 mm behind the trim front (Shawn 2026-10-23: "板子后移 6.6 mm"); the eye opening grows to dia 16.2, with the same 45 deg flare outside. Front face otherwise unchanged (checks.json frontUnchangedOutsideBore). Four M2 x 6 into the bosses (C-camera-01..04), 4.4 mm of thread. The two side key pockets for the eye-trim tabs at (AY -/+ 7.7, AZ - 4.5) are filled through the 1.3 mm front skin: the bore cut into them, leaving 0.35 mm; the trim loses its two side tabs and the top key pair stays.
